snippet.title: Goblin Hoarder | Cozy Goblin Sorting Game | November 25 on Steam
snippet.description:
Wishlist Goblin Hoarder on Steam - Launching November 25th, 2026
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5378450/Goblin_Hoarder/

Goblin’s cave is messy. Help a goblin sort shinies, potions, and a pot of things nobody asks about... and burn any human books you find.

🗓 Launching November 25, 2026 on Steam for $5.99
🎮 Full controller support · Steam Deck ready
 - Runs great on lower end gaming pcs.
- Language friendly


#GoblinHoarder #CozyGames #indiegame
